note: S17 mission areas (D63c/D64). Compound scale: 24x16 with courtyards. All times in ticks at 10Hz. Guards are disable-only (D6): a takedown puts one down for guardDownTicks, exactly like combat does people. Terminals suppress the area alarm and are the junction-box's indoor cousin. Surveillance holds tick ONLY while unseen - hiding IS the gameplay.
note_tiles: Area tile ids reuse the street vocabulary where it fits: 0 open court, 1 corridor, 4 wall (impassable), 5 door (entry/exit), 8 cover crates. Walls block movement AND sight.
